_schema: Exemptions for check-firewall-membership.py --census (GOL-2576, GOL-2582).
AN EMPTY ALLOWLIST IS THE GOAL STATE. Every entry here is a box, a rule, or a
database that the census would otherwise fail on: a droplet behind no cloud
firewall, a firewall that allows :22 from the whole internet, or a managed
database cluster with empty or world-open trusted sources. Adding one does not
make the exposure safe -- it records that a human looked, decided to accept it
for now, and named the issue that will close it.
Every entry MUST carry:
id       DO droplet id (number), firewall id (uuid) or database cluster id
(uuid) -- the stable key
name     live name at time of writing; a mismatch is reported, not fatal
issue    GOL-NNNN tracking the fix. Enforced by regex; no issue, no exemption.
expires  YYYY-MM-DD. PAST THIS DATE THE ENTRY STOPS SUPPRESSING AND BECOMES
A FINDING ITSELF, so a 'temporary' exposure cannot quietly become
permanent by nobody re-reading this file.
why      one line a reviewer can judge without opening the issue
A cluster that has become CLEAN is reported too, so a stale entry gets pruned
rather than sitting here forever covering nothing.
Example (do not uncomment -- copy the shape):
{ "id": 123456789, "name": "some-droplet", "issue": "GOL-0000",
